script_text: Stop, Pisces — your water element is flooded, and Neptune, your ruling planet, is sitting in your money house with Saturn right behind it. Neptune is transiting your 2nd House of Money in a soft sextile to your Sun, so income feels dreamy and values feel vague. Saturn in that same house demands receipts, boundaries, proof. Meanwhile, the Sun is stepping into Sagittarius, the sign of your traditional ruler Jupiter, trining Jupiter in your 6th House of Daily Work and igniting your 10th House of Career. Love: that Neptune sextile makes you magnetic but foggy — singles, someone charming appears; couples, don't confuse generosity with devotion. Career: the Sun-Jupiter trine lands a contract, raise, or rate conversation today, so say your number out loud. Warning: Pluto in your 12th House is surfacing an old wound — don't sign, spend, or send anything emotional tonight. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
